name: M0V_HD19305.fits

header.COMMENT:
FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) format is defined in 'Astronomy
and Astrophysics', volume 376, page 359; bibcode 2001A&A...376..359H

Please reference Rayner et al. (ApJS, 185, 289) if you use this
spectrum.  The spectrum has been absolutely flux calibrated using
2MASS photometry and has been shifted to zero radial velocity.  For
other pertinent information, please see Rayner et al. (ApJS, 185,
289).

The spectra are stored in a 2D array where:

Wavelength   = array[*,0]
Flux Density = array[*,1]
Error        = array[*,2]

Finally, missing data are denoted as NaN.

provenance.reference: Cushing, Rayner & Vacca 2005 ApJ 623 1115; Rayner, Cushing & Vacca 2009 ApJS 185 289
provenance.catalogue: IRTF Spectral Library (IRSA public mirror); original version 2009-12-01
provenance.note: Illustrative observed templates; not a complete M/L/T/Y classification grid. Missing wavelengths and atmospheric gaps must remain missing.

label: Observed illustrative template; approximate CBAND boxcar average; target-noise-only scale uncertainty, not a spectral classification.
